messages:
alex: seeing a repeatable stall in sampleapp streaming when an upstream proxy returns 429 + Retry-After during reconnect. node and python clients both. anyone familiar?

riley: can you share a tiny repro and which SDK versions?

alex: node sampleapp 0.9.2, python 0.6.3. repro: start stream, force proxy to 429 on reconnect, client reconnects with Last-Event-Id but then we see broken chunks and parser hangs. logs: 
```
[INFO] reconnecting lastId=evt_77
[WARN] upstream 429 retry-after=1
[INFO] connected
DEBUG recv: "data: {\"id\":\"evt_78\", \\"text\": \\"Hel"
DEBUG recv: "lo\n\n"
ERROR parser: unexpected EOF waiting for event terminator
```

frank: two likely issues: header dropped on auth refresh, or partial chunk buffer not carried across reconnect. python SDK historically rebuilt headers on refresh and lost Last-Event-Id.

riley: we should also guard the parser: accumulate until full "\n\n" delimiter seen, and on reconnect carry over partial buffer. also tag events with seq num to detect reorder.

alex: i'll add a local nginx case to CI that returns 429 mid-stream and asserts assembled events match.

frank: i'll PR a small header-preserve fix for python and a unit test.

riley: i'll PR parser buffering + duplicate/reorder detection for node.

token-bot: created issue #1482: "SSE stall on 429 reconnect (sampleapp)" with logs and nginx conf.

alex: thanks. once patches land we'll canary on staging sampleapp.
